rationale: PoE branch adds output.z_loss (a detached metric tensor with requires_grad=False) into combined_loss; the z_loss value shows in metrics but contributes zero gradient. Detection reads requires_grad attr on every tensor summed into combined_loss before backward — must be True. schema_topo_precond: precond is 'tensor is operand of combined_loss in PoE branch'. P4 over P1 because requires_grad on a runtime tensor is not in standard trace; needs forward hook. Borderline value_equality vs other: requires_grad must equal True (constant).
